description: 🆕 b20-supply shows the dilution ceiling; this shows the actual printing. Every mint (incl. batchMint) in the window: amount, recipients, and the share of current supply it represents — heavy_dilution / active_minting / minor_minting / quiet. The live issuance feed for agents holding B20 stablecoins and RWAs. Pass days= (1-90, default 30).
